framing_assertion.rationale: The initial request assumes that rejected shipment notices can be auto-fixed and resubmitted by an AI agent.

hypotheses.statement: Rejected notices are due to correctable errors that an AI agent can fix and resubmit.
hypotheses.rationale: If true, an automated fix-and-resubmit solution would resolve the problem; if false, a different approach is needed.

hypotheses.statement: Rejects result from malformed or missing fields in shipment notices that violate carrier schema.
hypotheses.rationale: If true, fixing data quality at source or enhancing validation would be required; auto-fix may still work if errors are simple.

hypotheses.statement: Carrier recently updated validation rules, causing previously valid notices to be rejected.
hypotheses.rationale: If true, solution must track rule versions and adapt mappings; auto-fix would need rule awareness.

hypotheses.statement: Delayed or incomplete handoff from shipper to carrier leads to partial notices being rejected.
hypotheses.rationale: If true, improving handoff timeliness or completeness would reduce rejects; auto-fix of partial data may be insufficient.

output.root_cause: Missing location (LOC_UNKNOWN) and incorrect event ordering (EVENT_ORDER) fields in shipment notices cause carrier rejections (E-01, A-REJECTION-CAUSE).

remedies.description: Add mandatory pre-submission validation at the shipper (ORG-A) to check for presence and correctness of location and event-order fields before generating shipment notices (E-01, A-REJECTION-CAUSE).
remedies.feasibility_rationale: Can be configured via form/rules update within the remaining 150 minutes.
remedies.residual_gap: Potential other data quality issues beyond location/event order remain unknown (U-FIX-SUFFICIENCY).

remedies.description: Assign data quality ownership to the shipper with an SLA requiring zero LOC_UNKNOWN and EVENT_ORDER rejects, monitored via the carrier reject log (E-01).
remedies.feasibility_rationale: Organizational agreement can be drafted quickly; no tool changes needed.
remedies.residual_gap: Potential other data quality issues beyond location/event order remain unknown (U-FIX-SUFFICIENCY).

remedies.description: Insert a schema validation step in the handoff (H-1) that blocks notices missing location or incorrect event order from reaching the carrier (E-01).
remedies.feasibility_rationale: A lightweight validation tool can be deployed within the remaining time.
remedies.residual_gap: Potential other data quality issues beyond location/event order remain unknown (U-FIX-SUFFICIENCY).

work_items.description: Query the carrier reject log to list rejected notices and reasons.
Validate shipment notices against carrier schema using reject log as reference.
Resubmit corrected notices to the carrier after fixing location and event-order fields.

output.rationale: The release scope specifies inspect_reject_log, validate_shipment_notice, and resubmit_notice as core steps to eliminate LOC_UNKNOWN and EVENT_ORDER rejects. Evidence E-01 shows three rejects (2 LOC_UNKNOWN, 1 EVENT_ORDER) confirming the need for these actions (PD-1). No mutating tools are defined, so no protected actions are required at this stage. Side effects are limited to read-only queries; resubmit would transmit notices if a mutating tool existed. Reads are reversible; resubmit is not. Alternatives include bypassing validation or delaying resubmission until data-fix sufficiency is verified.
